title: The second Kahn–Kalai conjecture
summary: We prove the second Kahn–Kalai conjecture. For every finite simple graph H with h ≥ 1 edges and at most n vertices, the threshold for $`G(n,p)`$ to contain an ordinary copy of H is at most $`C p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)(1+\log_2 h)`$, where C is universal. Here $`p_{\mathrm E}(n,H)`$ is the least density at which every subgraph of H has expected copy count at least one half.
family_title: The second Kahn–Kalai conjecture with an edge-count bound

review.reason: Gives a threshold bound for containing a fixed graph in G(n,p), resolving the second Kahn-Kalai conjecture.
